title: Centered second Gaussian moment
statement:
For every $c\in\mathbb R$ and $v\ge0$, the Gaussian measure $N(c,v)$ on $\mathbb R$ satisfies
\[
\int_{\mathbb R}(z-c)^2\,dN(c,v)(z)=v.
\]
replaced: For every $c\in\mathbb R$ and $v\ge0$, a random variable $Z\sim N(c,v)$ satisfies $\mathbb E(Z-c)^2=v$, including the point-mass law when $v=0$.
